name: Motorcycle Simulator Mississippi
summary:
Ride Jackson, Mississippi from the seat - solo or with your friends.

42 KM ROUND JACKSON
I-55 south past Fondren and Veterans Memorial Stadium, the State Capitol dome and the downtown towers, I-20 west round the south of the city past Jackson State, and I-220 north through west Jackson and the pines back to I-55. Real roads, real terrain, real skyline.

RIDE ONLINE TOGETHER
Up to four riders in a room. Quick Ride joins an open room or opens yours; Private Room gives you a 4-digit code for your friends. See
